MIND. [1] [Bufo]
Weak memory ; idiotic. θ Spasms.
Mind not affected. θ Epilepsy.
Easily laughs or cries ; cries much. θ Epilepsy.
Great anguish. θ Meningitis.
   

SENSORIUM. [2] [Bufo]
Attacks were ushered in by numbness of brain. θ Epilepsy.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Bufo]
Dull headache in left side. θ Softening of brain.
Headache, with epilepsy.
Violent orgasm in head.
Congestive headache, with flushed face. θ Epilepsy.
   

OUTER HEAD. [4] [Bufo]
Lancinations in occiput, inclining head to fall backward. θ Meningitis.
Head was at first drawn to one side, either right or left, then backward, before an attack. θ Epilepsy.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Bufo]
More acute vision, and eyes less sensitive to wind.
Pupils largely dilated and unaffected by light before attack. θ Epilepsy.
Eyes became highly injected ; shrunken and lifeless in appearance, as the attacks multiplied. θ Epilepsy.
Right eye open, left nearly closed ; eyeballs rolled upward and to left before attack. θ Epilepsy.
Left lid paralyzed, hangs down. θ Softening of brain.
Edges of eyelids red and some crusts in lashes. θ Epilepsy.
Eyes sunken during spasm. θ Epilepsy.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Bufo]
Beating in heart reverberates in ears. θ Meningitis.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Bufo]
Distortion and turgescence of face ; mouth and eyes convulsed ; profuse sweat on face.
First muscles of face commenced to twitch, extending thence over whole body. θ Epilepsy.
Face greyish ; red, bloated during spasms.
Copious sweat running down face.
Face bathed in sweat during spasm. θ Epilepsy.
   

TEETH AND GUMS. [10] [Bufo]
Toothache.
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Bufo]
A kind of lapping motion of tongue, feeling of face and rubbing of nose before attacks. θ Epilepsy.
Stuttering ; stammering ; gets angry when incoherent speech is not understood. θ Chorea.
Bites the tongues.
Tongue cracked, bluish-black.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Bufo]
Mouth wide open before an attack. θ Epilepsy.
Sanguinolent salivation.
Bloody saliva. θ Spasms.
During violent agitation of muscular system, ejection of frothy, bloody saliva from mouth. θ Epilepsy.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Bufo]
Fearful sore throat, could eat neither supper nor breakfast for it ; verified at another time in same person.
Eruption in pharynx, like spots on skin. θ Epilepsy.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Bufo]
Nausea in morning for a week.
Yellow fluid in vomit, like that from eruption. θ Epilepsy.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Bufo]
The attack originates in abdomen. θ Epilepsy.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Bufo]
Dysentery, with delirium, headache and sleeplessness.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Bufo]
Urine passes off involuntarily. θ Softening of brain.
During violent agitation of entire muscular system, discharge of urine. θ Epilepsy.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Bufo]
Impotence of worst kind ; produced in some and cured in others.
Buboes.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Bufo]
Burning and swelling of ovaries.
Burning heat and stitches in ovaries.
Swelling and great sensitiveness of ovarian region.
Violent cramps in ovarian region, extending into groins.
Hydatids in ovaries.
Distending, burning pains or cramps in uterus ; sharp, dagger-like pains ; worse on walking or sitting too long. θ Carcinoma uteri.
Enormous blisters on tumefied uterus, discharging a thin, serous, yellow fluid. θ Epilepsy.
Spasms occur just before menses. θ Epilepsy.
Attacks worse at time of menses, which return every three weeks. θ Epilepsy.
Yellow fluid in leucorrhœa, like from eruption. θ Epilepsy.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Bufo]
Hæmaturia in childbed.
Cancer mamma occultus.
Mammary cancer.
Tumefaction like a cord from groin to knee. θ Milk leg.
Child became epileptic in consequence of mother having a fright or fit of anger during nursing period.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Bufo]
After convulsive movements became less rapid and violent, breathing became heavy and stertorous, with usual puffing of lips at every expiration, directly culminated in a deep-drawn sigh, and patient sank into coma, soon followed by the restlessness and convulsions as before. θ Epilepsy.
   

COUGH. [27] [Bufo]
Cough nocturnal, provoked towards 3 or 4 A. M. by a tickling in larynx, which he feels only at this hour.
Cough in consequence of cold feet.
Violent cough, with vomiting.
Cough dry, with sharp pain or burning in chest.
Sputa mucous or sanguinolent, or formed of pure blood, raised most in morning and evening, with sensation of cold in chest ; a sensation which is often succeeded by heat and congestion.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Bufo]
Laryngitis, hæmoptysis, phthisis pulmonalis.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Bufo]
Pulse became more and more rapid and threadlike as the paroxysms multiplied. θ Epilepsy.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Bufo]
Attacks ushered in by a jerk in nape of neck. θ Epilepsy.
A swelling of bone size of fist. θ Caries of dorsal vertebræ.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Bufo]
Arms became stiffened before an attack. θ Epilepsy.
Numbness of left arm. θ Epilepsy.
A blister in hand which recurred annually.
After a slight contusion of (little) finger, tearing pain, with redness along whole arm, following lymphatic vessels into armpit, causing there painful glandular swellings.
Contractions of fingers of right hand, then left, followed the lapping motion of tongue, with thumbs drawn into palms ; before an attack. θ Epilepsy.
Panaritium ; pains run in streaks all the way up arm.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Bufo]
Ischias.
Lower limbs are more in motion than upper.
Lower limbs straight and stiff before attack. θ Epilepsy.
Lower limbs get weak, has to take first one stick, then two to be able to walk. θ Softening of brain.
Podagra.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Bufo]
Swelling of hands and arms ; burning pains. θ Erysipelas.
   

REST. POSITION. MOTION. [35] [Bufo]
Pain in limbs since months, he is bent and cannot walk without a stick. θ Caries of dorsal vertebræ.
Each attack heralded by restless movements of limbs and body. θ Epilepsy.
   

NERVES. [36] [Bufo]
Repeated shocks through whole body.
Up to period of beginning, muscles were in a state of tonic contraction, but then jactitations or twitchings commenced. θ Epilepsy.
Twitching over whole body increased rapidly in severity, till entire muscular system became violently agitated. θ Epilepsy.
Tonic and clonic spasms.
Loss of consciousness and falling down.
Convulsions. θ Epilepsy (after fright).
Epilepsy after onanism. Compare Sulphur.
Spasms caused by or associated with suppuration of internal parts.
Convulsion of limbs. θ Softening of brain.
Spasms : from fright ; at new moon ; after onanism ; during coitus.
Before spasm : angry for several days ; face greyish-yellow, eyes sunken ; jerks in back of neck.
During attack : face distorted, red, biting tongue ; bloody saliva ; violent movements of limbs ; profuse sweat.
After attack : spasmodic movements of intestines ; profound sleep.
Falls to ground unconscious, with a blood-curdling, wild cry, followed by spasms in limbs ; distorted facial muscles, grinding teeth and foaming mouth ; ending in loud, snoring sleep. θ Epilepsy.
Spasms very severe, followed by sleep. θ Epilepsy pain.
Attacks come on in sleep, are followed by severe pain and pressure in top of head. θ Epilepsy.
Dreadful paroxysm several times a week. θ Epilepsy.
Fifty paroxysms occurred during fifteen hours, with complete unconsciousness. θ Epilepsy.
Paralysis.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Bufo]
After a deep-drawn sigh, patient sank away into a comatose condition, from which no effort could rouse him. θ Epilepsy.
Very profound coma subsequent to attacks. θ Epilepsy.
Stupid sleep after epileptic attack.
At midnight seized with convulsions, recurring every twenty minutes till 4 P. M. of next day.
   

TIME. [38] [Bufo]
Attacks appear with change of moon. θ Epilepsy.
   

TEMPERATURE AND WEATHER. [39] [Bufo]
Headache and flushed face much < in warm room or near stove ; > from cold bathing or in cold air. θ Epilepsy.
Putting feet in hot water and drinking something hot, sometimes breaks up the attack. θ Epilepsy.
   

FEVER. [40] [Bufo]
The limbs get cold, head and face increasingly hot, as paroxysms multiply. θ Epilepsy.
Hot head, cold body ; delirium or apathy ; constipation.
Bathed in sweat, weak ; spasms.
The body, and especially hands and arms, bathed in a clammy perspiration, as attack multiplied. θ Epilepsy.
Checked sweat, now very copious, most towards morning. θ Softening of brain.
Cold sweat.
Quartana.
   

ATTACKS, PERIODICITY. [41] [Bufo]
Every week, on one day, four attacks. θ Epilepsy.
About once on week, always in night, followed by some hours of coma. θ Epileptic spasms.
Has from ten to twelve attacks yearly. θ Epilepsy.
Attacks since about five years. θ Epilepsy.
   

SENSATIONS. [43] [Bufo]
If awake she has some warning, from a feeling of general numbness, immediately followed by a spasm. θ Epilepsy.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Bufo]
Redness and swelling along course of lymphatics, after wounds, etc. See 24, 32.
Open cancer.
   

TOUCH. PASSIVE MOTION. INJURIES. [45] [Bufo]
Tendency of wounds to suppurate, with throbbing and lancinating pains.
Depression of skull from a horse's kick on occiput. θ Epilepsy.
Convulsions after having teeth extracted. θ Epilepsy.
When suppurations seem to be the cause of convulsions. θ Epilepsy.
   

SKIN. [46] [Bufo]
Stitches in skin prevent sleep at night. θ Softening of brain.
Red or purplish streaks in neck, back or other parts. θ Meningitis.
Skin greenish, dirty, oily, or greyish-yellow. See 36.
Pompholyx in hand returning every year.
Phlyctenoid eruption, discharging a thin, yellow fluid, similar to that appearing in vomit and leucorrhœa. θ Epilepsy.
Bluish-black swelling around (thumb) nail, followed by suppuration. θ Panaritium.
Ulcers, with burning pains.
Malignant pustule.
Carbuncles ; blue far around.
Carbunculus pestilentialis.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Bufo]
Boy, æt. 11, good constitution ; epileptic attack six months ago, without apparent cause.
Woman, æt. 30, wreck in mind and body from epilepsy.
Woman, æt. 40, suffered thirty years with epileptic spasms.
Woman, æt. 24, suffered for more than a year with epilepsy.
